summary: Phase 2 E2E testing. Backend: 40/40 pytest pass (21 new Phase 2 tests + 19 regression). Coverage: offers admin CRUD (percent+code, bogo+categories, fixed+min_order, combo), public /api/offers hides code-locked offers, /offers/apply computes percent/bogo(2nd unit free)/fixed(capped)/combo correctly, coupon code case-insensitive, invalid code -> code_valid=false and offer not applied, /api/orders recomputes subtotal/discount/total server-side + stores applied_offers + accepts coupon_code, scheduled_for validation (<25min=400, valid=201, scheduled_enabled=false=400), /api/admin/orders/{id} auth (401 no auth, 200 admin), all static files (manifest/sw/robots/sitemap/logo/icon-192) return 200, index.html contains 'Telecanto' + ld+json. Frontend: Home offers-strip + /logo.png render; Cart cart-discount shows -7.50€ for 2× bogo pizza; Checkout coupon TELE10 -> coupon-status 'Ενεργό κουπόνι' + applied-offer-* row -0.75€ + total reduced; schedule-later reveals schedule-input; Admin offers page CRUD (create/toggle/delete) works; /admin/orders status-preparing button now clickable (audio overlay bug fixed, no emergent-overlay-host); /admin/print/{id} renders full ticket with items/totals/scheduled time. TWO NEW BUGS FOUND on customer-facing order completion flow.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful order submit, `clear()` empties cart which fires Checkout's `useEffect(() => { if (items.length===0) nav('/') }, [items])` — this races with the subsequent `nav('/order/${data.id}')`. Result: user lands on Home (/) instead of the Order Confirmation page. Repro: any successful checkout (guest or logged-in). Fix: guard the redirect useEffect so it doesn't fire after a submission (e.g., useRef flag set before clear()), or nav to /order/{id} BEFORE calling clear() (nav happens synchronously in React Router; then clear can run in a microtask).

The page fetches orders via `/api/orders/mine` which requires authentication. For guest checkouts (majority of pizza-ordering users) this returns 401 and `order` stays null — the page shows only the header/'Παραγγελία σου καταχωρήθηκε' but hides the details block (Παραγγελία #, Τρόπος, Ώρα for scheduled, Έκπτωση, Σύνολο). Also causes the request test 'Order confirm shows Ώρα' to fail. Fix: add a public `GET /api/orders/{id}` endpoint (or fetch by id from stored guest-order data) and use that. Combined with the redirect bug above, guest users effectively never see the confirmation page.

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end broken: submit → toast success is shown but user is redirected to '/' rather than /order/{id}, and even if routed correctly, OrderConfirm can't fetch guest orders. Backend order is created successfully (verified via /admin/orders/{id}).

issues: <span> as child of <option> causes hydration warning (from x-tool instrumentation). Cosmetic, no functional impact — same as iter1.
Still missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby (a11y warning) — same as iter1, unresolved.

action_items: Fix Checkout.jsx: prevent items-empty redirect from firing after order submit. Option A: set `submittedRef.current=true` before clear() and check it in the redirect useEffect. Option B: nav('/order/${id}') first, then clear() in a setTimeout(...,0).

Add public `GET /api/orders/{oid}` endpoint (or expose the created order back to Checkout via localStorage and read it in OrderConfirm) so guest orders can be viewed. Update OrderConfirm.jsx to use it instead of /orders/mine.
(Optional carryover) Fix DialogDescription/aria-describedby a11y warning on ProductModal and Products admin dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py compute_offers: bogo uses `sorted(units, reverse=True)[1::2]` which discounts every 2nd unit from the CHEAPER pairs (correct semantics for pairing highest-with-lowest but ensure it matches store policy of '2ο τεμάχιο δώρο'). Currently OK.

server.py create_order: server recomputes subtotal/discount/total (good) but retains client-sent `delivery_fee` unchecked — a malicious client can pass delivery_fee=-100. Consider recomputing from zone.fee on the server.

server.py: scheduled_for validation compares parsed datetime to now+25 min while the error message says '30 λεπτά'. Message/validation mismatch (25 vs 30) — user-facing bug when scheduling at the boundary.
OrderConfirm: uses /orders/mine (auth) → guests can never see their confirmation. Need /api/orders/{oid} public endpoint.
Checkout: useEffect redirect races with nav after submit — actual bug repro'd.

rca of the issue: Checkout redirect: React batches the state updates from clear() (items→[]) and the imperative nav('/order/{id}') from react-router-dom. On commit, the still-mounted Checkout re-renders once with items=[] before route change unmounts it; the redirect useEffect sees items.length===0 and calls nav('/'), which overrides the previous nav('/order/{id}'). OrderConfirm broken for guests: OrderConfirm.jsx line 11 calls http.get('/orders/mine') — this endpoint has require_user dependency in server.py:317 which returns 401 without a Bearer token → catch swallows it → order state stays null → UI renders header + generic success text only, hiding the details block (which contains 'Ώρα' for scheduled orders).
